PR: Dual field support for function resource requirements [closed]
### Description of your changes

Fixes https://github.com/crossplane/function-sdk-go/issues/219

This change introduces better-named fields for function resource requirements while maintaining full backward compatibility. The protobuf now includes `required_resources` (request) and `resources` (requirements) fields alongside the existing deprecated `extra_resources` fields.

The implementation uses symmetric behavior: functions using the old `extra_resources` field receive resources in the old field, while

functions using the new `resources` field receive them in `required_resources`. Bootstrap requirements from Compositions and Operations only use the new field names, since bootstrap requirements are new in v2. Existing functions continue working unchanged, while new functions can adopt the improved naming convention.
